registryBasis: A first-party Dongtai municipal government page identifies the local Natural Resources and Planning Bureau as the registration, cadastral-survey, real-estate-surveying, and public geographic-information custodian. An official procurement record identifies the Tianditu·Dongtai public geographic-information platform. These establish local custody and a public-platform reference, not open machine-readable parcel geometry.
assessment: Dongtai's official registry and mapping responsibilities are evidenced, but current anonymous requests did not produce a parcel ID, schema, CRS, or polygon. No GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime readiness remains held.
